description: This file defines request handlers for TTS (Text-to-Speech) operations in a gateway server, including status, enable/disable, convert, set provider, and list providers functionalities.

methods.name: tts.status
methods.description: Handles retrieval of TTS status, including enabled state, auto mode, provider info, fallback providers, and provider states.

methods.name: tts.enable
methods.description: Enables TTS functionality by setting the enabled state to true.

methods.name: tts.disable
methods.description: Disables TTS functionality by setting the enabled state to false.

methods.name: tts.convert
methods.description: Converts text to speech audio, returning the audio path and related info.

methods.name: tts.setProvider
methods.description: Sets the current TTS provider based on provided provider ID.

methods.name: tts.providers
methods.description: Lists available TTS providers with their configuration and active provider.
